name: zumpo
description: Repo-level tooling. The two applications live in server/ and client/ and keep their own dependencies.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server ci && npm --prefix client ci
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client run typecheck && tsc -p e2e
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix client test
scripts.e2e: npm run build && playwright test -c e2e
scripts.design:compare: npm run build && playwright test -c e2e/screens.config.ts
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run format:check && npm run design:tokens -- --check && npm test && npm run build
